formula_zh: (收盘价 - 30期最低价) / (30期最高价 - 30期最低价 + eps)
intuition_en: Measures price continuation over 30h. Higher values indicate stronger recent upward drift.

known_limitations_en: Medium-window range position; can flip interpretation between breakout continuation and overbought reversal.
